name: The Wizards' War
description: The war in which the Guardian and the Guilds defeated Lim-Dûl a second time.

description_citations.text: "Magic: The Gathering (MicroProse)/Backstory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Wizards' War Lim-Dûl's spirit, having won over Azaar's, emerges to conquer Shandalar but is defeated; the Guardian imprisons him in an artifact.
timeline.quote: In the great Wizards' War , Lim-Dûl was defeated soundly, though the Lord of the Black Guild also fell.
